nodes.label: AI Loader Animation
nodes.description: Animated GIF used as an AI processing loader. Depicts a central 'AI' node (purple rounded rectangle) connected via golden circuit-like lines to four surrounding icons: a text icon (green square with 'T'), a video/play icon (pink circle with play triangle), a microphone/audio icon (teal microphone), and an image icon (navy rectangle with mountain/landscape). Represents AI processing multiple content modalities (text, video, audio, image). Used as a loading indicator in AI-related UI contexts.
